snippet.title: Stick RPG Complete Flash Game Playthrough
snippet.description:
Stick RPG by XGen Studios is one of the most popular flash games ever.  Though basic and grindy, it was exactly what we all wanted back in the day.  Just a simple stick figure flash game RPG.

There's plenty of fun small details and hilarious dialogues that just did it for everyone.  The McSticks, bar fights, grinding for money and stats.  We all wanted to see how far we could stretch Stick RPG.
